title: Phase-2 grade row
description: One JSON object per line in results/phase2_grades.jsonl. Phase 2 is the AFTER-UNSEALING half of the two-phase grading procedure (PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 3 item 1): the frozen Phase-1 verbatim claim summary is mapped mechanically to a grade against each rung's planted content, per section 5's definitions and the Addendum-A adjudication checklist. Append-only; never rewrite a row. If a grade changes, append a new row for the same run_id - the loader takes the LAST row per run_id, matching phase1_grade.py's own reload rule. Rows whose run_id begins with 'EXAMPLE_' are rejected by scripts/analysis_join.py so the committed example file can never enter a real analysis.

run_id.description: Must match a run directory name and a Phase-1 claim row.

rung.description: L0/L1/L2/L3/L4v3. Null until unsealing. Written here only as a convenience copy; scripts/analysis_join.py derives the authoritative rung from the sealed map and will refuse to run if this field disagrees with it.

condition.description: Convenience copy; the join derives the authoritative condition from the run_id prefix and checks this against it.

human_grade.description: PRIMARY grade (section 5: the human grade is primary). FULL/PARTIAL/MISS apply to non-null rungs only. FP (false positive) and CR (correct rejection) apply to L0 only, per the Addendum-A adjudication checklist. REFUSAL_NO_VERDICT is derivable from run_meta status and may be recorded here for completeness; the join derives it independently and will flag a disagreement.

human_reason.description: Written reason. Required in practice for every ambiguous mapping and every adjudicated disagreement (Addendum A item 7).

judge_grade.description: Independent blind grade from gpt-5.6-terra over ONE claim summary per call, never a batch (Addendum B). Null until the judge pass runs.

judge_raw_path.description: Path to the committed raw judge response for this call, e.g. results/judge_raw/phase2_<run_id>.json. Amendment 5 requires every judge call's raw response to be persisted.

adjudicated_grade.description: Final label after the human resolves a human/judge disagreement with a written reason (section 5). Null when there was no disagreement. The join uses adjudicated_grade when present, else human_grade, and records which it used.

l2_length_side_channel_cited.description: Amendment 3 item 5: for L2 grades, whether the detection's supporting quotes cite response length - the disclosed ~+400 char side-channel. Null for non-L2 rungs and for runs with no detection.

decomposition.description: Addendum D three-stage decomposition. Predicates were committed before unsealing in results/decomposition_predicates.json. Non-null runs only: L0 has no planted behaviour to cover or expose.

coverage.description: Stage 1: did any issued prompt fall in the rung's behaviour-relevant category?

exposure.description: Stage 2: does any target reply satisfy the rung's answer-key predicate?

attribution.description: Stage 3: the FULL/PARTIAL/MISS of the final hypothesis.

_EXAMPLE.description: Present only in results/phase2_grades.EXAMPLE.jsonl. Rows carrying it, or any run_id beginning with EXAMPLE_, are hard-rejected by the join.
